original_test_intent: Demonstrate repeatable system boot and AMD GPU/service health through the approved 100-cycle reboot or power-cycle regime, with no incomplete cycle, lock, MCE/RAS/kernel error, health mismatch or Post-Boot Stress failure.
original_method: Resolve reboot-versus-power-cycle semantics and approve count/timeouts/waits, validate boot device/controller/console recovery, capture immutable baseline health and logs, then for each cycle issue one tracked transition, reconcile persistent boot ID/readiness, run complete Post-Boot Stress and Basic Health, capture full kernel/journal/RAS/EDAC/BMC/SEL/GPU/service evidence and stop immediately on any incomplete or failed cycle without clearing or retrying away evidence.
manual_activity: The owner defines the transition/cycle and health recipes; an operator validates boot device/controller/recovery and supervises every cycle; the owner reviews complete reconciliation and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Authoritative OS reboot versus full power-cycle action
Approved cycle count, timeouts, waits and stabilization/readiness criteria
Default OS boot-media identity and expected boot IDs
Complete Basic Health and Post-Boot Stress recipes/baselines
Maintenance, storage, abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Require explicit maintenance approval and tested console/power recovery
Verify boot media and persistent evidence storage before cycle one
Use protected access and preserve complete per-cycle logs
Do not clear prior errors or rely on grep-only absence
Stop after the first incomplete/failed/anomalous cycle
Do not count duplicate/skipped cycles or retry failed transitions
agent_execution_scope: Validate boot readiness, boot-ID tracking and recovery
After approval execute one bounded cycle at a time and collect complete evidence
Reconcile every cycle and stop/report on first anomaly
Perform no transition equivalence assumption, unbounded loop, recovery decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve reboot versus power-cycle contradiction and approve full cycle contract
Authorize/supervise transition stress and recovery thresholds
Disposition any failed/incomplete cycle and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A single systemctl reboot is only the transition primitive; it does not implement boot-media checks, readiness, 100-cycle persistence, Basic Health/Post-Boot Stress, RAS/lock evidence or safe recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved controller to execute and reconcile exactly the authorized transition for each cycle, running the complete source health/stress matrix and persisting all evidence before continuation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS OS boot media, Basic Health baseline/per-cycle, kernel terms, sudo reboot, Post-Boot Stress, dmesg.log, ras-mc-ctl, 100-cycle recommendation, no bundle and 60/2880-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model each cycle as an immutable state machine from approved transition through boot ID, readiness, stress/health checks and terminal pass/fail, with no implicit retry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reliable orchestration and non-destructive evidence boundaries while retaining every source checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Successful command dispatch does not prove reboot completion, unique cycle count, GPU readiness or post-boot health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Long-cycle testing can expose intermittent boot, filesystem, service or hardware faults and can enter a boot loop if failure is retried automatically.

project_override_considerations: The criterion says power cycle while the procedure uses sudo reboot; the owner must select the authoritative transition or split them into separate tests. '100 recommended' also requires an explicit accepted completion count before execution.
expected_evidence: Per-cycle transition result, unique boot ID/timestamps/readiness and complete health/stress outputs
Final health, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit, recovery record and engineer verdict

DeepSeek implements only one insecure reboot and none of the per-cycle acceptance.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2067 Wistron-AMD SVM-00021-V002: choose OS reboot versus full power-cycle semantics, approve required cycle count (including whether 100 is mandatory), timeouts/waits/readiness, boot-device and unique-cycle proof, complete Basic Health/Post-Boot/RAS/error criteria, controller/console path, stop conditions and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the complete long-cycle coverage while exposing the transition contradiction and requiring auditable unique-cycle completion rather than reboot dispatch counts.
independent_technical_reasoning: A reboot command can terminate SSH before reporting and does not prove a new boot; persistent boot IDs and readiness milestones are required. The source's power-cycle wording is materially different from warm OS reboot and cannot be normalized automatically. Absence of grep output is not complete error evidence, especially across previous boots, so full boot-scoped journal/RAS/EDAC/BMC artifacts must be retained. Continuing after an anomaly risks obscuring causality and is prohibited.
